sentences.text: S1 stated that everything told to her is confidential and covered by legal privilege, and that she would make a note of the meeting.
S2 confirmed the meeting was about his mum's house on Wyvern Road.
S2 stated his mum died in June.
S2 stated the house was left to him and his brother Neil, fifty-fifty.
S2 stated there is a will and that he and Neil are both executors.
S2 stated probate has not been applied for yet.
S2 stated Neil won't sign anything and is living in the house, saying he is not moving out.
S2 stated an estate agent valued the house at about two hundred and eighty thousand, but Neil wouldn't let them in for a proper valuation.
S2 stated things between him and Neil have been 'Bad. Really bad.'
S2 stated he fell into a door while being clumsy.
S2 stated Neil punched him in the face.
S2 stated the assault happened on Saturday the 7th of November.
S2 stated he went to the house to get Mum's paperwork.
S2 stated they started arguing in the kitchen about the sale, and Neil said he was being robbed.
S2 stated Neil punched him with no warning.
S2 stated Neil broke his nose.
S2 stated there was blood everywhere after the punch.
S2 stated he went to Castlebrook General A and E hospital that night.
S2 stated the hospital x-rayed his nose and said it was broken.
S2 stated after being punched, Neil picked up a kitchen chair and hit him across the back and shoulder.
S2 stated he had bruising all down his back for a week.
S2 stated if Neil had had a knife in his hand, he thinks Neil would have used it.
S2 stated Neil did not have a knife or pick one up at any point.
S2 stated he got up and walked out of the house.
S2 stated he drove himself to hospital, which he admitted was 'stupid'.
S2 stated he has not reported the assault to the police.
S2 stated his mum would have hated it if he reported the assault.
S2 stated Neil has sent texts saying he deserved it and he is not getting a penny.
S2 stated he has the discharge letter from the hospital.
S2 stated he took photos of his face the next day.
